creationCharge.note: Existing production recipient/network configuration is preserved; no Testnet recipient or donation waiver is assumed.

buyEstimate.scope: Local pristine-genesis estimate, not a live quote; revalidate before approval

preconditions.deploy: Exact StateInit/code/data hashes; account must have no conflicting active/frozen code.
preconditions.initialize: Curve uninitialized, expected admin and all four candidate identities.
preconditions.mint: Curve INITIALIZING, master supply zero, operator still admin. Mint exactly once; poll original message on uncertainty, never resubmit blindly.
preconditions.renounce: Master supply exactly 1B and actual Curve-wallet custody verified; Curve RENOUNCE_PENDING; operator admin. Renunciation is irreversible.
preconditions.buy: Master admin null, Curve ACTIVE, same network and approved fresh min-out quote; verify delivered Jettons and persistent receipt, not wallet approval.
preconditions.sell: Read actual owned wallet balance and fresh net-TON quote; approve a new exact min-out payload after buy confirmation.

migration.reason: Curve dispatch/finalization and migration finalize remain blocked with 414; no approved real transition or funding plan.

requirements: Verify connected operator raw address and Testnet chain -3, account control, funding, current code/data and fee estimates.
Approve Testnet metadata and creation charge recipient; preserve mandatory 0.20 + 0.02 TON.
Approve exact individual messages and fresh quote limits before any signature. No validUntil/signing session is generated here.
For every action verify exact external/inbound message hashes, transaction compute/action phases, descendants and persistent operation records through protected TON Center reads.
LP receipt lost before locker execution cannot be backfilled from an off-chain snapshot. Independent foreign source/code/custody review and Curve handoff confirmation remain required.
Stop on unknown outcomes; retry gas-only queries of the same operation. Never resend principal because an acknowledgement is absent.
